name: Velantis Thermcore Mid Boot
description: A sleek ankle boot with a smooth, slightly structured silhouette available in charcoal, navy, and sand. A thin thermoregulation layer embedded in the lining uses body heat exchange to keep foot temperature within a comfortable range regardless of ambient conditions — warm in cold corridors, cool in summer streets. The exterior looks entirely conventional.
functionality: Passive thermoregulation membrane maintains foot temperature between 18–24°C in ambient conditions from -10°C to 40°C.
what_it_says: Quiet competence. You've spent money on something that works rather than something that looks like it works.
story_hooks: The thermoregulation layer can be reverse-engineered to mask body heat from thermal scanners — someone is doing exactly that.
A batch of Thermcore Mids shipped with a faulty membrane that traps heat instead of dissipating it — the recall hasn't gone public yet.

physical_description.visual_profile: A refined ankle boot with a tapered silhouette that bridges utilitarian function and minimalist elegance. The design reads as contemporary corporate-casual, neither overtly tech-forward nor dated. Sits at mid-ankle with a subtle forward rake, creating a dynamic visual line when standing.
physical_description.fit: Snug through the arch and heel with structured ankle support; slightly roomy in the toe box for circulation. The silhouette appears slim without compression, suggesting engineered efficiency rather than fashion excess.
physical_description.primary_material: Premium synth-leather exterior with subtle grain texture; thermoregulation mesh lining visible at the cuff seam
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost glass-like outer surface with micro-grain detailing; inner lining is soft, breathable mesh with embedded conductive filaments barely perceptible to touch
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in charcoal (matte, light-absorbing), navy (subtle satin undertone), and sand (warm, neutral); minimal accent stitching in matching thread tone
physical_description.closures: Full-length concealed side zip with smooth pull tab; friction-fit ankle collar with subtle elastic reinforcement
distinctive_features: Embedded thermoregulation layer—no visible vents or grilles, maintaining clean aesthetic
Barely-noticeable seam pattern around the cuff indicating the tech integration
Subtle Velantis Systems logo (small, embossed, left heel counter)
Conductive mesh lining creates faint shimmer under direct light
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 luxury—high-end corporate augmentation without ostentation
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals corporate professional or corpo-adjacent worker who values invisible tech integration; someone who commutes between climate-controlled executive zones and street-level meetings. Practical for someone who works across multiple GLMZ thermal zones.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; develops subtle scuff patterns on the toe box and heel from daily wear; the lining may show mild discoloration from sweat after months of use, but the thermoregulation efficiency remains stable
